def optimal_score(m, matrix):
    # Calculate the prefix sums for both rows
    prefix_sum_row1 = [0] * (m + 1)
    prefix_sum_row2 = [0] * (m + 1)
    
    for j in range(1, m + 1):
        prefix_sum_row1[j] = prefix_sum_row1[j - 1] + matrix[0][j - 1]
        prefix_sum_row2[j] = prefix_sum_row2[j - 1] + matrix[1][j - 1]
    
    # Calculate the total sum of coins in the matrix
    total_sum = prefix_sum_row1[m] + prefix_sum_row2[m]
    
    # Alice wants to minimize Bob's score, so Alice will try to make Bob collect the minimum coins
    # Bob will try to maximize his coins
    
    # Calculate the maximum coins Bob can collect by choosing the optimal path
    max_bob_coins = 0
    for j in range(1, m + 1):
        # Bob's coins if he goes down at column j
        bob_coins_down = prefix_sum_row2[j] - prefix_sum_row2[0]
        # Alice's coins if she goes right to column j
        alice_coins_right = prefix_sum_row1[j]
        # Total coins collected by both Alice and Bob if they follow their optimal strategies
        total_coins = total_sum - (bob_coins_down + alice_coins_right)
        # Update the maximum coins Bob can collect
        max_bob_coins = max(max_bob_coins, total_coins)
    
    # The score of the game is the total number of coins Bob collects
    return max_bob_coins
